purpose: Complete integrated method development; no component ablations this round
subset: exact frozen v5 development20; remaining80 forbidden until method freeze
schedule: all three GPUs independently load the same complete model; Omni Joint then AV, VideoLLaMA Joint then AV
pipeline: one marked global call: candidate, bounded evidence, visible paired address or NONE, temporal relation
agreement retains native; disagreement with justified uncapped event anchor optionally replays <=12s
isolated verifier sees original global and fresh local evidence only
revise only if free-generation verifier agrees with candidate; else native
new_generation: greedy seed42; candidate enum A-D followed by evidence <=48 tokens, visible paired-frame enum or NONE and relation enum; verifier free generation
memory: Candidate-conditioned event ledger used only for proposal and window choice. Verifier receives no candidate/proposal ledger. Valid index is not verified factual localization.
revision: Agreement retains native. Disagreement requires separate evidence compartment verification. Unreadable/truncated proposal or unconfirmed revision retains native.
audio_budget: Native global policy unchanged. Local crop may add audio evidence absent from native sparse/first300s coverage. Report as additional input, not memory-only or equal-compute gain.
scoring: same frozen v5 parser; AV official first-letter primary plus strict secondary; all planned questions count, missing/unparsed/errors wrong
cost: new cold application-cache work plus reused native recorded seconds; initialization and technical pilot separately; OS cache uncontrolled
technical_pilot: Same24 after all four address reads pass: native text/media/token parity, repeated proposal, outside-box equality, source mapping/audio/cache isolation, budgets; no QA accuracy gate.
selection: One unified method across all four groups; complete whole round before next decision, retain all versions.
novelty_status: Hypothesis only: evidence-addressed bounded acquisition plus isolated verification, no established novelty or generalization gain.
stop: one full round then evidence-based next-version review; no blind endless GPU occupation; OOM at most three process attempts per shard, other errors diagnosed
repair: Independent candidate after V13 replay visual/source-clock review; no accuracy-based interface selection.
control_parser: Frozen joint_parser for native and free verifier; candidate syntax-constrained A-D, separate from unchanged formal scorer
memory_validation: Uncapped descriptive evidence, visible valid non-GLOBAL pair, clip>12.001s and pair source-time span<=12s; no unknown-gap fallback.
initial_prompt_metadata: Visible paired address codes; no dense source-second table. Initial pixels changed; native/local/verifier remain unmarked.

marker.encoding: two adjacent input frames share Pxx

address_probe: Fixed first technical-pilot clip per group, middle marked pair repeated to native frame count; free readout <=16 tokens without expected code in prompt. All four exact readings required. Synthetic OCR only, no QA labels or score. Failure stops this version.
pixel_change: Initial prepared video copy receives black/white top-left marker. Same shapes/frame indices/audio, not same pixels or equal-media baseline.
